# The differences make compat allows between a binary's outputs and v1's
# recorded ones (testdata/golden/cli). One a line:
#
#   <board> <case> <what> <reason>
#
# board: a golden board's name, or *; case: a case's name from its
# index.txt, a prefix ending in *, or *; what: exit, stdout, stderr or *.
# The reason is required: every difference is a decision, said here.
#
# None: git-board prints what v1 printed, byte for byte.
